Anna (SecOps): FYI we detected repeated session reuse against the API Gateway admin routes from a small set of IPs. Looks like automated credential stuffing + session replay. No production data exfil, but long-lived cookie/session secrets allowed reuse. Need immediate mitigations and a short remediation window.

Jordan (SRE): +1. Observed ~1200 requests over the last 10 minutes, 3 successful admin-session reuses (staging creds). I rate-limited the source CIDRs and blocked them at the edge.

Kai (Platform): Thanks for the heads-up. Action plan?

Anna (SecOps): Immediate actions (0-2h):
- Rotate API gateway session signing secret and web cookie secret for all envs (prod+/staging/test).
- Enforce per-route ephemeral JWT kid rotation on admin endpoints.
- Tighten rate limits on /admin/* and /internal/* to 5 req/min per IP and enable early 429.
- Block the observed CIDR ranges at WAF and CloudEdge.

Jordan (SRE): I'm on the rate limit + WAF rules. Adding temporary rule now.

Luca (DevEx): I'll push guidance to engineers about short-lived tokens and update the SDK to emit a warning when using legacy session cookies. ETA 60m for PR.

Kai (Platform): For secret rotation, steps:
```
# rotate cookie secret in k8s (example)
kubectl -n platform set secret api-cookie-secret --from-literal=secret=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
# deploy rolling update
kubectl -n platform rollout restart deploy/api-gateway
```
Also toggle feature flag to require kid header on admin JWTs: feature/admin_jwt_kid=true

Anna (SecOps): We also need a post-incident audit: list of services that accept long-lived session cookies and owners + a PR to expire cookies to 1h by default. Assigning owners: @Jordan for gateway, @Luca for SDKs, @Kai for infra JWT handling.

Jordan (SRE): Done WAF rule and rate limit applied. Initiating secret rotation now, will post the rollout status.

deploy-bot: deployment api-gateway v3.14.2 rolling restart started by Jordan  10 pods to restart.

Anna (SecOps): After rotation, please run these checks and paste output here:
1) curl -I -H 'Cookie: session=<old-cookie>' https://admin.redwood-inference.internal/admin/health (should 401)
2) internal audit query: SELECT service, cookie_max_age FROM config WHERE cookie_max_age > 3600;

Kai (Platform): Running the curl check now, will confirm. Also adding a follow-up task to enforce shortlived CI tokens for deploy pipelines.

Luca (DevEx): PR opened to SDK with warning + migration doc: https://go/redwood/devex/sdk-cookie-migration (draft).

Jordan (SRE): Rotation completed. Old cookie now rejected: HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized. WAF blocked 12 offending IPs. Rolling restart completed, logs show successful reconnects.

Anna (SecOps): Good. Next steps (24-72h):
- Audit all services for long-lived session acceptance and file remediation PRs.
- Add monitoring rule: anomalous admin auth reuse > 3 in 5m => pager to oncall.
- Shorten default cookie TTL to 1h and force-expire existing sessions.
- Schedule postmortem doc and timeline: due in 48h.

Kai (Platform): I'll create the monitoring alert and add it to runbook.

Jordan (SRE): Noted. I'll take the postmortem draft.

Anna (SecOps): Thanks team :thumbsup: If you find any tenants still using legacy tokens, @mention me and we'll treat as P1 until rotated.

Luca (DevEx): FYI the SDK warning PR contains a code snippet for migrating to short-lived tokens and the telemetry flag to opt-in.

Anna (SecOps): Closing the immediate thread  will post the incident summary and remediation checklist in ~2h.

Jordan (SRE): Thanks everyone.
